-- PRIVILEGED MUTATING ROLLBACK-ONLY DRAFT. SQL UNPARSED/UNEXECUTED.
-- Requires separately admitted DIRECT synthetic target/function owner, exact
-- source/profile, actual CHECK/default catalog reconciliation, fixture/cleanup
-- packet and actual producer-created scoring snapshots + consent/current leases.
-- Settings select exact owned fixtures; they do NOT authorize this run.
-- Synthetic claims/counters here do NOT represent actual provider requests.
-- No SDK, global queue claim, real candidate content, app grants or backfill.
-- The on descriptor MUST be generated by the actual Node source factory using
-- an ALREADY ADMITTED R03 fixture policy/opening; never seed free/zero pricing.
begin;
set local statement_timeout='20s';
set local lock_timeout='1s';
set local idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='25s';
set local search_path='';
create function pg_temp.ifo_assert(p_ok boolean,p_label text) returns void
language plpgsql set search_path='' as $$
begin if p_ok is not true then raise exception 'INITIAL_FEEDBACK_FIXTURE_ASSERT: %',p_label using errcode='23514';end if;end;
$$;
do $ifo_cases$
declare off_id uuid:=nullif(current_setting('resumide.feedback_off_analysis',true),'')::uuid;
 on_id uuid:=nullif(current_setting('resumide.feedback_on_analysis',true),'')::uuid;
 owner_id_value uuid:=nullif(current_setting('resumide.feedback_owner',true),'')::uuid;
 on_policy jsonb:=nullif(current_setting('resumide.feedback_on_policy',true),'')::jsonb;
 input_reservation text:=nullif(current_setting('resumide.feedback_reserved_input',true),'');
 off_policy jsonb:=$actual_off_policy${"version":"initial-feedback-publication/1.0.0","provider":"openai","model":"gpt-6-luna","promptVersion":"qualitative-cited-prose/3.0.0","maxOutputTokens":1200,"attemptLimit":1,"budgetPolicyVersion":null,"supportVersion":"qualitative-content-support/1.0.0","supportSha256":"230f22333dd468f3bf78395b118330ec1ff78de18be9da5349356e84d0f6bd13","planVersion":"initial-feedback-plan-policy/1.0.0","planSha256":"972b648ccc90b29c0c88fc504ac2746ab1489e17f05cfd2048cb487a2b38cc48","writingSupportPolicyVersion":"legacy-source-transforms/1.0.4","scoringInputProfile":{"schemaVersion":"legacy-scoring-readiness/1.0.0","profileVersion":"legacy-scoring-profile/1.0.0","checkerSha256":"56a92f65d533a2f1b053078dbb372b1271728224e5df1c74b201b4cffb21a8d3","readerSha256":"2ea3c5071d8d56e421a37053127dea08fe8eb08ce91e4de9f5c3b4c4b1172ccf","finishSha256":"5db61206ed04f32af7052fce2d64e2ccf414d6fea13645f58eecf67f616b61a2","contextSha256":"d64ba9ac11ba732c983cd195cd7d83fba878e67f4ae0bffc8b6e166a600a8bd9","exportSha256":"e4c17997fdbec81d931e4838b3522c6c7d3c861b0bfa07b6fb3ab5ece160f0a2","metadataSha256":"f18e6abfd698c4dbf4f7f6040fb577b2e49e78e4125bfd9d31e8166d0e678da8"},"planProfile":{"schemaVersion":"initial-feedback-plan-readiness/1.0.0","profileVersion":"initial-feedback-plan-profile/1.0.0","policyVersion":"initial-feedback-plan-policy/1.0.0","policySha256":"972b648ccc90b29c0c88fc504ac2746ab1489e17f05cfd2048cb487a2b38cc48","checkerSha256":"c5d8c0e8e5ac52c8b06a4fad5ea78f6fe6e42297bbbfd51cd2779243c8418b36","rendererSha256":"c8bc131aacc7f9ddd8e30dcca8f5f429e78ee84180e5dd4542254883001cedc6","metadataSha256":"3c133694d11334e9430821945c94782b562ab1efb3f26bb8d4e7a9f2699369c5"},"sha256":"5f5eace5226885c3bbaf6c430e656034edbb3f12e42ffa4634faffd8f94619ca"}$actual_off_policy$::jsonb;
 a public.analyses%rowtype;b public.analyses%rowtype;j public.analysis_jobs%rowtype;s private.analysis_scoring_inputs%rowtype;
 lease_value jsonb;selector jsonb;first jsonb;replay jsonb;won jsonb;lost jsonb;settled jsonb;metadata jsonb;op uuid;att uuid;binding_sha text;
 request_value jsonb;reserved jsonb;budget jsonb;pool_before numeric;pool_after numeric;denied boolean;function_owner name;
 first_on_attempt uuid;second_on_attempt uuid;third_on_attempt uuid;
begin
 select rolname into function_owner from pg_catalog.pg_roles where oid=(select proowner from pg_catalog.pg_proc
   where oid=to_regprocedure('public.prepare_initial_feedback(uuid,jsonb,jsonb,uuid)'));
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(current_user=function_owner and off_id is not null and on_id is not null and off_id<>on_id and owner_id_value is not null,
   'separate_owner_fixture_admission_required');
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(private.ifo_policy_valid(off_policy) and private.ifo_policy_valid(on_policy)
   and off_policy->'budgetPolicyVersion'='null'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof(on_policy->'budgetPolicyVersion')='string'
   and on_policy->>'model'=off_policy->>'model' and on_policy->'attemptLimit'='3'::jsonb and input_reservation collate "C" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$'
   and input_reservation::numeric<=9007199254740991,'actual_source_descriptors_required');
 metadata:=public.read_initial_feedback_operation_readiness();
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(metadata->>'schemaVersion'='initial-feedback-operation-readiness/1.0.0'
   and metadata->'schemaReady'='true'::jsonb and metadata->'prepareExecutable'='false'::jsonb
   and metadata->'claimExecutable'='false'::jsonb and metadata->'settleExecutable'='false'::jsonb,'staged_metadata_not_adoption');
 select * into strict a from public.analyses where id=off_id and owner_id=owner_id_value;
 select * into strict b from public.analyses where id=on_id and owner_id=owner_id_value and organization_id=a.organization_id;
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(a.status='qualitative_review' and b.status='qualitative_review'
   and not exists(select 1 from private.initial_feedback_operations where analysis_id in (off_id,on_id))
   and exists(select 1 from private.analysis_scoring_inputs x join private.analysis_scoring_inputs y on y.analysis_id=on_id
     where x.analysis_id=off_id and x.owner_id=owner_id_value and y.owner_id=owner_id_value and x.resume_id<>y.resume_id)
   and exists(select 1 from public.consents where user_id=owner_id_value and purpose='qualitative_ai' and policy_version='candidate-ai-v1'),
   'two_original_bound_current_owned_fixtures_required');
 -- Owner-only temporary seeding is fixture work inside this admitted rollback;
 -- the migration seeds nothing and app/service roles cannot select budget mode.
 insert into private.initial_feedback_policies(version,sha256,descriptor)
 values(off_policy->>'version',off_policy->>'sha256',off_policy),(on_policy->>'version',on_policy->>'sha256',on_policy);
 insert into private.initial_feedback_selections(organization_id,policy_version,policy_sha256,enabled)
 values(a.organization_id,off_policy->>'version',off_policy->>'sha256',true);
 select * into strict j from public.analysis_jobs where analysis_id=off_id;
 lease_value:=jsonb_build_object('workerId',j.lease_owner,'attempt',j.attempt_count,'leaseFence',j.lease_fence);
 selector:=jsonb_build_object('version',off_policy->>'version','sha256',off_policy->>'sha256');
 first:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(off_id,lease_value,selector,null);
 op:=(first->'operation'->>'operationId')::uuid;att:=(first->'attempt'->>'attemptId')::uuid;binding_sha:=first->'operation'->>'bindingSha256';
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(first->>'status'='prepared' and first->'context'->>'generationEligibility'='eligible'
   and first->'dispatchAllowed'='false'::jsonb,'fresh_prepare_no_dispatch');
 replay:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(off_id,lease_value,selector,null);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(replay->>'status'='pending' and replay->'context'='null'::jsonb
   and replay->'dispatchAllowed'='false'::jsonb and replay->'operation'=first->'operation','exact_prepare_replay_no_context');
 won:=public.claim_initial_feedback_dispatch(off_id,lease_value,op,att,binding_sha,null);
 lost:=public.claim_initial_feedback_dispatch(off_id,lease_value,op,att,binding_sha,null);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(won->'dispatchAllowed'='true'::jsonb and lost->'dispatchAllowed'='false'::jsonb
   and lost->'replayed'='true'::jsonb and (select count(*)=1 from private.initial_feedback_attempts where operation_id=op),'one_claim_only_budget_off');
 settled:=public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,null,'timeout');
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(settled->>'state'='held_unknown' and settled->'usage'='null'::jsonb,'unknown_is_not_zero_or_retry');
 select * into strict s from private.analysis_scoring_inputs where analysis_id=off_id;
 update public.resumes set status='deleted' where id=s.resume_id and owner_id=owner_id_value;
 settled:=public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,'{"inputTokens":"13","outputTokens":"2"}'::jsonb,'timeout');
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(settled->>'state'='failed' and settled->'usage'='{"inputTokens":"13","outputTokens":"2"}'::jsonb,'late_known_after_source_withdrawal');
 replay:=public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,null,null);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(replay->'replayed'='true'::jsonb and replay->'usage'=settled->'usage','null_cannot_clear_known');
 denied:=false;
 begin perform public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,'{"inputTokens":"14","outputTokens":"2"}'::jsonb,'timeout');
 exception when sqlstate 'P0C01' then denied:=true;end;
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(denied,'changed_known_conflicts');
 -- On mode uses the real unchanged R03 reserve/claim and existing approved pool.
 update private.initial_feedback_selections set policy_version=on_policy->>'version',policy_sha256=on_policy->>'sha256' where organization_id=a.organization_id;
 select * into strict j from public.analysis_jobs where analysis_id=on_id;
 lease_value:=jsonb_build_object('workerId',j.lease_owner,'attempt',j.attempt_count,'leaseFence',j.lease_fence);
 first:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(on_id,lease_value,jsonb_build_object('version',on_policy->>'version','sha256',on_policy->>'sha256'),null);
 op:=(first->'operation'->>'operationId')::uuid;att:=(first->'attempt'->>'attemptId')::uuid;binding_sha:=first->'operation'->>'bindingSha256';
 request_value:=jsonb_build_object('operationId',op,'attemptId',att,'attemptOrdinal',1,'surface','qualitative','payloadSha256',binding_sha,
   'model',on_policy->>'model','promptPolicyVersion',on_policy->>'promptVersion','policyVersion',on_policy->>'budgetPolicyVersion',
   'reservedInputTokens',input_reservation,'reservedOutputTokens',on_policy->>'maxOutputTokens');
 reserved:=public.ai_budget_reserve(owner_id_value,a.organization_id,request_value);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(reserved->>'status'='ok' and reserved->'receipt'->>'state'='reserved','actual_r03_reservation_required');
 budget:=jsonb_build_object('p_user_id',owner_id_value,'p_organization_id',a.organization_id,'p_request',request_value);
 won:=public.claim_initial_feedback_dispatch(on_id,lease_value,op,att,binding_sha,budget);
 lost:=public.claim_initial_feedback_dispatch(on_id,lease_value,op,att,binding_sha,budget);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(won->'dispatchAllowed'='true'::jsonb and won->'budget'->'receipt'->'dispatchAllowed'='true'::jsonb
   and won->'attempt'->>'budgetAttemptId'=att::text and lost->'dispatchAllowed'='false'::jsonb
   and (select count(*)=1 from private.ai_budget_events where attempt_id=att and kind='dispatch'),'same_tx_one_claim_budget_on');
 select spent_tokens into strict pool_before from private.ai_budget_pools where organization_id=a.organization_id and period=(reserved->'receipt'->>'period')::date;
 perform public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,'{"inputTokens":"13","outputTokens":"2"}'::jsonb,null);
 select spent_tokens into strict pool_after from private.ai_budget_pools where organization_id=a.organization_id and period=(reserved->'receipt'->>'period')::date;
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(pool_after=pool_before and not exists(select 1 from private.ai_budget_events where attempt_id=att and kind='settle'),
   'technical_mirror_has_no_second_debit');
 -- Actual budget settlement remains the original single accounting operation.
 perform public.ai_budget_settle(owner_id_value,a.organization_id,request_value||jsonb_build_object('usage',jsonb_build_object('inputTokens','13','outputTokens','2')));
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert((select count(*)=1 from private.ai_budget_events where attempt_id=att and kind='settle'),'one_original_budget_settlement');
 -- Focused historical selector oracle: actual attempts1 ->2 ->3, then exact
 -- retryAfterAttempt1 must return its already-created attempt2, not allocate4.
 -- Requires the admitted R03 fixture policy/opening to allow at least3 attempts.
 first_on_attempt:=att;
 perform public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,att,binding_sha,null,'timeout');
 first:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(on_id,lease_value,jsonb_build_object('version',on_policy->>'version','sha256',on_policy->>'sha256'),first_on_attempt);
 second_on_attempt:=(first->'attempt'->>'attemptId')::uuid;
 request_value:=request_value||jsonb_build_object('attemptId',second_on_attempt,'attemptOrdinal',2);
 reserved:=public.ai_budget_reserve(owner_id_value,a.organization_id,request_value);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(reserved->>'status'='ok','actual_second_r03_reservation_required');
 budget:=jsonb_build_object('p_user_id',owner_id_value,'p_organization_id',a.organization_id,'p_request',request_value);
 won:=public.claim_initial_feedback_dispatch(on_id,lease_value,op,second_on_attempt,binding_sha,budget);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(won->'dispatchAllowed'='true'::jsonb,'second_exact_claim');
 perform public.settle_initial_feedback_attempt(op,second_on_attempt,binding_sha,'{"inputTokens":"13","outputTokens":"2"}'::jsonb,'timeout');
 perform public.ai_budget_settle(owner_id_value,a.organization_id,request_value||jsonb_build_object('usage',jsonb_build_object('inputTokens','13','outputTokens','2')));
 first:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(on_id,lease_value,jsonb_build_object('version',on_policy->>'version','sha256',on_policy->>'sha256'),second_on_attempt);
 third_on_attempt:=(first->'attempt'->>'attemptId')::uuid;
 replay:=public.prepare_initial_feedback(on_id,lease_value,jsonb_build_object('version',on_policy->>'version','sha256',on_policy->>'sha256'),first_on_attempt);
 perform pg_temp.ifo_assert(replay->>'status'='pending' and replay->'context'='null'::jsonb and replay->'dispatchAllowed'='false'::jsonb
   and replay->'attempt'->>'attemptId'=second_on_attempt::text and (replay->'attempt'->>'ordinal')::integer=2
   and second_on_attempt<>third_on_attempt and (select count(*)=3 from private.initial_feedback_attempts where operation_id=op)
   and (select count(*)=2 from private.ai_budget_events where attempt_id in (first_on_attempt,second_on_attempt,third_on_attempt) and kind='dispatch'),
   'consumed_selector_returns_its_original_successor_without_new_claim');
end;
$ifo_cases$;
set constraints all immediate;
rollback;
-- OPEN: actual CHECK/default reconciliation, roles, two-session CAS/lock order,
-- concurrent policy/source/consent/lease withdrawal, UTC-boundary behavior and
-- all publication/privacy/shared-counter/retention/adoption lifecycles.
-- No single-session assertion is a concurrency/lock-contention proof.
